overview_description.description: Locofy provides a service that converts designs into code. Locofy.ai aims to take away the menial work of engineers without adding complexity i.e. automating 50% or more of the current workflow starting with frontend code, allowing teams to convert their designs to code and an interactive and responsive live prototype (that runs on code), without writing a single line of code.

about_short_description.short_description: Locofy provides a service that converts designs into code.

product.name: Locofy.ai Design-to-Code Platform
product.description: A platform that converts design files from tools like Figma and Adobe XD into production-ready frontend code for web and mobile applications.

product.name: Locofy Builder
product.description: A web-based tool to manage, extend, and export frontend code generated from design files, allowing component creation, prop configuration, and code synchronization.

identifier.value: Locofy.ai Plugin for Figma and Adobe XD

product.name: Locofy.ai Plugin for Figma and Adobe XD
product.description: A plugin that integrates with design tools to convert design elements into interactive, responsive frontend code with tagging and styling options.

product.name: GitHub Integration and Smart Merge
product.description: A feature that synchronizes generated frontend code with GitHub repositories, enabling conflict resolution and incremental updates to keep design and code in sync.

product.name: Auto-Tagging and Auto-Components Features
product.description: AI-powered tools that automatically identify design elements for tagging and suggest reusable components to streamline code generation.
